The `topology_boundary_auditor` confirmed a clean mask (0.97 confidence), and `perceptual_quality_auditor` found no distortion. The high pose risk is likely a domain-shift artifact rather than a structural failure. I will downgrade the severity of this signal but keep the score slightly below perfect to account for the ambiguity in the feet/tail details.
